content.answer_markdown: This Recommendation proposes these Trade Lines to rebalance the Portfolio back to its Target Allocation by Asset Class. Currently, the Portfolio has significant drift from target: equity is overweight at 60.0% versus a 45.0% target (+15.0 percentage points, breach), bonds are underweight at 35.0% versus a 45.0% target (-10.0 percentage points, breach), and cash is underweight at 5.0% versus a 10.0% target (-5.0 percentage points, warning). The Trade Lines include selling equity-related holdings (e.g., SPY, XLE, XOM, JNJ, PG) and buying bond-related holdings (e.g., AGG, LQD, SGOV, SHY) to bring the Portfolio allocations closer to the targets. The turnover of these trades is 14.99% of the Portfolio, which is within the threshold for requiring compliance approval. The post-trade drift figures show that after these trades, the Portfolio will be very close to target allocations with minimal drift (around 0.01 percentage points), and the suitability rules mostly pass except for a single-position limit breach on XOM. This rebalancing is rule-based and band-based, with no research tilt applied.
